title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 10, 2026, relative to Placing Hold on Impounded
text:
[4. REGULAR AGENDA ITEM]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 10, 2026, relative to Placing Hold on Impounded
  Vehicle and/or Vessel Vehicle – Revised; Auto Release Portal – Established; Management of Vehicle
  Evidence Holds – Established; and, Release of Vehicle Evidence Holds – Established, as set forth.
  [BPC #26-306] [Redlined Version]
  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s Report.
summary: Approval of revised procedures for managing impounded vehicles and evidence holds, including auto release portal and new management protocols.
